G3700.et: a (middle voice) prolonged form of the primary (middle voice) optomai {op'-tom-ahee}, which is used for it in certain tenses, and both as alternate of (3708)
G3700.def: to gaze (i.e. with wide-open eyes, as at something remarkable; and thus differing from «991», which denotes simply voluntary observation; and from «1492», which expresses merely mechanical, passive or casual vision; while «2300», and still more emphatically its intensive «2334», signifies an earnest but more continued inspection; and «4648» a watching from a distance):--appear, look, see, shew self.

G3701.def: from a presumed derivative of «3700»; visuality, i.e. (concretely) an apparition:--vision.

G3702.et: from an obsolete verb akin to hepso (to "steep")
G3702.def: from an obsolete verb akin to hepso (to "steep"); cooked, i.e. roasted:--broiled.

G3703.et: apparently from the base of (3796) and (5610)
G3703.def: apparently from the base of «3796» and «5610»; properly, even-tide of the (summer) season (dog-days), i.e. (by implication) ripe fruit:--fruit.

G3704.def: from «3739» and «4459»; what(-ever) how, i.e. in the manner that (as adverb or conjunction of coincidence, intentional or actual):--because, how, (so) that, to, when.

G3705.def: from «3708»; something gazed at, i.e. a spectacle (especially supernatural):--sight, vision.

G3706.def: from «3708»; the act of gazing, i.e. (externally) an aspect or (internally) an inspired appearance:--sight, vision.

G3707.def: from «3708»; gazed at, i.e. (by implication) capable of being seen:--visible.

G3708.def: properly, to stare at (compare «3700»), i.e. (by implication) to discern clearly (physically or mentally); by extension, to attend to; by Hebraism, to experience; passively, to appear:--behold, perceive, see, take heed.

G3709.def: from «3713»; properly, desire (as a reaching forth or excitement of the mind), i.e. (by analogy), violent passion (ire, or (justifiable) abhorrence); by implication punishment:--anger, indignation, vengeance, wrath.

G3710.def: from «3709»; to provoke or enrage, i.e. (passively) become exasperated:--be angry (wroth).

G3712.def: from «3713»; a stretch of the arms, i.e. a fathom:--fathom.

G3713.et: middle voice of apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary [cf (3735)]
G3713.def: middle voice of apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary (compare «3735»); to stretch oneself, i.e. reach out after (long for):--covet after, desire.

G3714.def: from «3735»; mountainous, i.e. (feminine by implication, of «5561») the Highlands (of Judaea):--hill country.

G3715.def: from «3713»; excitement of the mind, i.e. longing after:--lust.

G3716.def: from a compound of «3717» and «4228»; to be straight-footed, i.e. (figuratively) to go directly forward:--walk uprightly.

G3717.def: probably from the base of «3735»; right (as rising), i.e. (perpendicularly) erect (figuratively, honest), or (horizontally) level or direct:--straight, upright.

G3718.et: from a compound of (3717) and the base of (5114)
G3718.def: from a compound of «3717» and the base of «5114», to make a straight cut, i.e. (figuratively) to dissect (expound) correctly (the divine message):--rightly divide.

G3719.def: from «3722»; to use the dawn, i.e. (by implication) to repair betimes:--come early in the morning.

G3720.def: from «3722»; relating to the dawn, i.e. matutinal (as an epithet of Venus, especially brilliant in the early day):--morning.

G3721.def: from «3722»; in the dawn, i.e. up at day-break:--early.

G3722.def: from the same as «3735»; dawn (as sun-rise, rising of light); by extension, morn:--early in the morning.

G3723.def: adverb from «3717»; in a straight manner, i.e. (figuratively) correctly (also morally):--plain, right(-ly).

G3724.def: from «3725»; to mark out or bound ("horizon"), i.e. (figuratively) to appoint, decree, specify:--declare, determine, limit, ordain.

G3725.et: from a derivative of an apparently primary horos (a bound or limit)
G3725.def: neuter of a derivative of an apparently primary horos (a bound or limit); a boundary-line, i.e. (by implication) a frontier (region):--border, coast.

G3726.def: from «3727»; to put on oath, i.e. make swear; by analogy, to solemnly enjoin:--adjure, charge.

G3727.et: from herkos (a fence, perhaps akin to (3725))
G3727.def: from herkos (a fence; perhaps akin to «3725»); a limit, i.e. (sacred) restraint (specially, an oath):--oath.

G3728.et: from a compound of (3727) and a derivative of (3660)
G3728.def: from a compound of «3727» and a derivative of «3660»; asseveration on oath:--oath.

G3729.def: from «3730»; to start, spur or urge on, i.e. (reflexively) to dash or plunge:--run (violently), rush.

G3730.def: of uncertain affinity; a violent impulse, i.e. onset:--assault.

G3732.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of «3733»; a birdling:--bird, fowl.

G3733.et: probably from a prolonged form of the base of (3735)
G3733.def: probably from a prolonged form of the base of «3735»; a bird (as rising in the air), i.e. (specially), a hen (or female domestic fowl):--hen.

G3734.et: from a compound of the base of (3725) and a derivative of (5087)
G3734.def: from a compound of the base of «3725» and a derivative of «5087»; a limit-placing, i.e. (concretely) boundary-line:--bound.

G3735.et: probably from an obsolete oro (to rise or "rear", perhaps akin to (142), cf (3733))
G3735.def: probably from an obsolete oro (to rise or "rear"; perhaps akin to «142»; compare «3733»); a mountain (as lifting itself above the plain): -hill, mount(-ain).

G3736.def: apparently a primary verb; to "burrow" in the ground, i.e. dig:--dig.

G3737.def: of uncertain affinity; bereaved ("orphan"), i.e. parentless:--comfortless, fatherless.

G3738.et: middle voice from orchos (a row or ring)
G3738.def: middle voice from orchos (a row or ring); to dance (from the ranklike or regular motion):--dance.

G3739.pos:
1. who, which, what, that
Wigram's count is 1309 not 1393.
G3739.et: probably a primary word (or perhaps a form of the article (3588))
G3739.def: probably a primary word (or perhaps a form of the article «3588»); the relatively (sometimes demonstrative) pronoun, who, which, what, that:--one, (an-, the) other, some, that, what, which, who(-m, -se), etc. See also «3757».

G3740.def: multiple adverb from «3739»; how (i.e. with «302», so) many times as:--as oft(-en) as.

G3741.def: of uncertain affinity; properly, right (by intrinsic or divine character; thus distinguished from 1342, which refers rather to human statutes and relations; from «2413», which denotes formal consecration; and from «40», which relates to purity from defilement), i.e. hallowed (pious, sacred, sure):--holy, mercy, shalt be. 342

G3745.pos: 1. as great as, as far as, how much, how many, whoever
G3745.def: by reduplication from «3739»; as (much, great, long, etc.) as:--all (that), as (long, many, much) (as), how great (many, much), (in-)asmuch as, so many as, that (ever), the more, those things, what (great, -soever), wheresoever, wherewithsoever, which, × while, who(-soever).

G3748.def: from «3739» and «5100»; which some, i.e. any that; also (definite) which same:--X and (they), (such) as, (they) that, in that they, what(-soever), whereas ye, (they) which, who(-soever). Compare «3754».

G3749.et: from ostrakon ["oyster"] (a tile, i.e. terra cotta)
G3749.def: from ostrakon ("oyster") (a tile, i.e. terra cotta); earthen-ware, i.e. clayey; by implication, frail:--of earth, earthen.

G3750.def: from a derivative of «3605»; smell (the sense):--smelling.

G3751.def: of uncertain affinity; the loin (externally), i.e. the hip; internally (by extension) procreative power:--loin.

G3752.pos: 1. when, whenever, as long as, as soon as
G3752.def: from «3753» and «302»; whenever (implying hypothesis or more or less uncertainty); also causatively (conjunctionally) inasmuch as:--as long (soon) as, that, + till, when(-soever), while.

G3753.pos: 1. when whenever, while, as long as
G3753.def: from «3739» and «5037»; at which (thing) too, i.e. when:--after (that), as soon as, that, when, while.

G3754.def: neuter of «3748» as conjunction; demonstrative, that (sometimes redundant); causative, because:--as concerning that, as though, because (that), for (that), how (that), (in) that, though, why.

G3755.et: for the genitive case of (3748) (as adverb)
G3755.def: for the genitive case of «3748» (as adverb); during which same time, i.e. whilst:--whiles.

G3756.pos: 1. no, not; in direct questions expecting an affirmative answer
G3756.et: a primary word, the absolute negative [cf (3361)] adverb
G3756.def: a primary word; the absolute negative (compare «3361») adverb; no or not:--+ long, nay, neither, never, no (X man), none, (can-)not, + nothing, + special, un(-worthy), when, + without, + yet but. See also «3364», «3372».

G3757.def: genitive case of «3739» as adverb; at which place, i.e. where:--where(-in), whither(-soever).

G3758.pos: 1. ah! ha! an interjection of wonder and amazement

G3759.def: a primary exclamation of grief; "woe":--alas, woe.

G3760.def: adverb from (the feminine) of «3762»; by no means:--not.

G3761.def: from «3756» and «1161»; not however, i.e. neither, nor, not even:--neither (indeed), never, no (more, nor, not), nor (yet), (also, even, then) not (even, so much as), + nothing, so much as.

G3762.def: from «3761» and «1520»; not even one (man, woman or thing), i.e. none, nobody, nothing:--any (man), aught, man, neither any (thing), never (man), no (man), none (+ of these things), not (any, at all, -thing), nought.

G3763.def: from «3761» and «4218»; not even at any time, i.e. never at all:--neither at any time, never, nothing at any time.

G3764.def: from «3761» and «4452»; not even yet:--as yet not, never before (yet), (not) yet.

G3765.def: from «3756» and «2089»; not yet, no longer:--after that (not), (not) any more, henceforth (hereafter) not, no longer (more), not as yet (now), now no more (not), yet (not).

G3766.def: from «3756» and «3767»; is it not therefore that, i.e. (affirmatively) hence or so:--then.

G3767.pos: 1. then, therefore, accordingly, consequently, these things being so
G3767.def: apparently a primary word; (adverbially) certainly, or (conjunctionally) accordingly:--and (so, truly), but, now (then), so (likewise then), then, therefore, verily, wherefore.

G3768.def: from «3756» and «4452»; not yet:--hitherto not, (no...) as yet, not yet.

G3769.def: apparently a primary word; a tail:--tail.

G3770.def: from «3772»; celestial, i.e. belonging to or coming from the sky:--heavenly.

G3771.et: from (3772) and the enclitic of source
G3771.def: from «3772» and the enclitic of source; from the sky:--from heaven.

G3772.et: perhaps from the same as (3735) (through the idea of elevation); the sky
G3772.def: perhaps from the same as «3735» (through the idea of elevation); the sky; by extension, heaven (as the abode of God); by implication, happiness, power, eternity; specially, the Gospel (Christianity):--air, heaven(-ly), sky.

G3773.def: of Latin origin; Urbanus (of the city, "urbane"), a Christian:--Urbanus.

G3774.def: of Hebrew origin («0223»); Urias (i.e. Urijah), a Hittite:--Urias.

G3775.def: apparently a primary word; the ear (physically or mentally):--ear.

G3776.def: from the feminine of «5607»; substance, i.e. property (possessions):--goods, substance.

G3777.def: from «3756» and «5037»; not too, i.e. neither or nor; by analogy, not even:--neither, none, nor (yet), (no, yet) not, nothing.

G3778.def: from the article «3588» and «846»; the he (she or it), i.e. this or that (often with article repeated):--he (it was that), hereof, it, she, such as, the same, these, they, this (man, same, woman), which, who.

G3779.def: adverb from «3778»; in this way (referring to what precedes or follows):--after that, after (in) this manner, as, even (so), for all that, like(-wise), no more, on this fashion(-wise), so (in like manner), thus, what.

G3780.pos: 1. not, by no means, not at all

G3781.def: from «3784»; an ower, i.e. person indebted; figuratively, a delinquent; morally, a transgressor (against God):--debtor, which owed, sinner.

G3782.def: from «3784»; indebtedness, i.e. (concretely) a sum owed; figuratively, obligation, i.e. (conjugal) duty:--debt, due.

G3783.def: from (the alternate of) «3784»; something owed, i.e. (figuratively) a due; morally, a fault:--debt.

G3784.et: or (in certain tenses) its prolonged form opheileo {of-i-leh'-o}; probably from the base of (3786) (through the idea of accruing)
G3784.def: probably from the base of «3786» (through the idea of accruing); to owe (pecuniarily); figuratively, to be under obligation (ought, must, should); morally, to fail in duty:--behove, be bound, (be) debt(-or), (be) due(-ty), be guilty (indebted), (must) need(-s), ought, owe, should. See also «3785».

G3785.pos: 1. would that, where one wishes that a thing had happened which has not happened or a thing be done which probably will not be done
G3785.et: first person singular of a past tense of (3784)
G3785.def: first person singular of a past tense of «3784»; I ought (wish), i.e. (interjection) oh that!:--would (to God).

G3786.et: from ophello (to heap up, i.e. accumulate or benefit)
G3786.def: from ophello (to heap up, i.e. accumulate or benefit); gain:--advantageth, profit.

G3787.def: from «3788» and «1397»; sight-labor, i.e. that needs watching (remissness):--eye-service.

G3788.def: from «3700»; the eye (literally or figuratively); by implication, vision; figuratively, envy (from the jealous side-glance):--eye, sight.

G3789.et: probably from (3700) (through the idea of sharpness of vision)
G3789.def: probably from «3700» (through the idea of sharpness of vision); a snake, figuratively, (as a type of sly cunning) an artful malicious person, especially Satan:--serpent.

G3790.et: perhaps from (3700) (through the idea of the shading or proximity to the organ of vision)
G3790.def: perhaps from «3700» (through the idea of the shading or proximity to the organ of vision); the eye-"brow" or forehead, i.e. (figuratively) the brink of a precipice:--brow.

G3791.def: from «3793»; to mob, i.e. (by implication) to harass:--vex.

G3792.def: from «3793» and «4160»; to make a crowd, i.e. raise a public disturbance:--gather a company.

G3793.et: from a derivative of (2192) (meaning a vehicle)
G3793.def: from a derivative of «2192» (meaning a vehicle); a throng (as borne along); by implication, the rabble; by extension, a class of people; figuratively, a riot:--company, multitude, number (of people), people, press.

G3794.et: from a remote derivative of (2192) (meaning to fortify, through the idea of holding safely)
G3794.def: from a remote derivative of «2192» (meaning to fortify, through the idea of holding safely); a castle (figuratively, argument):--stronghold.

G3795.et: from a presumed derivative of the base of (3702)
G3795.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of the base of «3702»; a relish to other food (as if cooked sauce), i.e. (specially), fish (presumably salted and dried as a condiment):--fish.

G3796.pos:
1. after a long time, long after, late
    1. late in the day, i.e. at evening
    2. the sabbath having just passed, after the sabbath
      1. at the early dawn of the first day of the week
G3796.et: from the same as (3694) (through the idea of backwardness)
G3796.def: from the same as «3694» (through the idea of backwardness); (adverbially) late in the day; by extension, after the close of the day:--(at) even, in the end.

G3798.def: from «3796»; late; feminine (as noun) afternoon (early eve) or nightfall (later eve):--even(-ing, (-tide)).

G3799.def: from «3700»; properly, sight (the act), i.e. (by implication) the visage, an external show:--appearance, countenance, face.
